description: This file defines the CalendarEventQuery class, which encapsulates criteria for querying calendar events, including filters such as start date, end date, calendar ID, and limit. It provides methods to retrieve these parameters, convert the query to an array, and generate descriptive string representations.

classes.name: CalendarEventQuery
classes.description: A class representing a query for retrieving calendar events with optional filters such as start date, end date, calendar ID, and limit. Provides methods for parameter access, array transformation, and string representation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CalendarEventQuery instance with optional start date, end date, calendar ID, and limit. Validates date range and limit value.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date filter for the query.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date filter for the query.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit on the number of results.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Transforms the query parameters into an associative array suitable for API or database queries.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string summarizing the query filters.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Magic method that returns the string representation of the query, aliasing to toString().
